title: 3 ways I made AI fun to learn
hook: Here are three ways I made AI fun to learn.
summary:
How to learn AI without it feeling like homework: build something you actually care about.
I built 3 things with AI:
1. Atlaria, a travel social media app (because I love travelling)
2. A Pokémon card portfolio tracker that shows what my collection is worth
3. A website for my favourite gelateria
Don't learn AI just to learn it. Start with finance, fashion, football, whatever you love, and build for that.
Comment BUILD and tell me what you'd make. I'll reply with where I'd start.
